name: Story Full Bleed
description: A single image carries the whole frame edge to edge, with a short headline set into a quiet region of the image and the brand mark and action held in the lower safe area. The picture persuades; the type only names and directs.
spacing: The type block sits inside the safe area over the calmest part of the image, with at least twice the headline's internal leading between it and the brand mark.
responsive_behavior: The image crops from the long edge toward its focal point so the type position holds across 9:16 and any taller variant without repositioning.
